Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment at
3425 North Lawndale Avenue

From RS-3 to RM- 4.5

1.A. The applicant and contract purchaser, 3425 Lawndale Apartments, LLC, is
seeking approval of a Type-1 Map Amendment from a RS-3 Residential Single-
Unit (Detached House) District to that of a RM- 4.5 Residential Multi-Unit
District in order to allow the proposed redevelopment of an existing 32,791.79 sq.
ft. lot, 42,104.0 three-story schoo! building, located at 3425 North Lawndale
Avenue.
The applicant is proposing to redevelop the existing school building in to a
proposed 28 dwelling-unit residential building with 24 vehicular off-street
parking spaces (one of which to be ADA accessible) with access via two existing
driveway facilities located on N. Monticello Avenue and two new proposed
driveway facilities to be added to N. Lawndale Ave. Proposal also includes 18
indoor bicycle spaces.
In order to facilitate the redevelopment of the existing school building, Applicant
are proposing to amend the current zoning classification from RS-3 to RM-4.5.
Applicant is seeking all relief as needed. as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code.
for the attached plans.
